checks.name: Synthetic records cover business, personal and the existing purchaser form; submitted versions are preserved after edits
Category/form/office/status filters combine before server pagination; counts, page two and mismatched filters are correct
Restricted reviewers can identify their archived forms while cross-office records, unrelated archived forms, draft columns and anonymous reads stay blocked
Browser filter controls limit form choices, reset the selected form/category page and preserve applied filters while paging
Managed entries show original form title/order/labels, contact inputs, choice labels, zero, No and blank fields; saved markup is escaped
Existing purchaser entries use every saved form input label and retain values independently of answer-object order
Submission list filters and Field/Value entries fit laptop, large monitor, tablet and phone widths
